name: SIGMA - UAC Bypass via Shell Open Command Hijack (ms-settings / mscfile)
description:
Detects writes to HKCU\Software\Classes\ms-settings\shell\open\command or
...\mscfile\shell\open\command. Auto-elevating binaries such as fodhelper.exe,
computerdefaults.exe (ms-settings) and eventvwr.exe (mscfile) look these per-user keys
up before the machine-wide ones, so a medium-integrity user can make them start an
arbitrary command at high integrity without a UAC prompt. There is no normal reason to
create these keys in HKCU, so the rule needs no filter.
